title: Patient switches from refill to booking and back

persona.name: Robert Alvarez
persona.style: easygoing, a little scattered, changes topic mid-thought
persona.extra: You take prescription ibuprofen, eight hundred milligrams, for your knee. Change your mind partway through like a distracted person would.

goals.goal: Start by asking for a refill of your ibuprofen eight hundred.
Partway through, say actually your knee's been worse and ask to book an appointment instead.
Once a time is offered or booked, go back and ask whether they can still send that refill too.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopaedics. Part of [company]. How may I help you today?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Hey, I'm calling to get a refill on my ibuprofen eight hundred, please.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I see you're calling from the number we have on file. Am I speaking with Maria?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Oh, actually it's Robert Alvarez. Sorry if that wasn't clear. Can I get that ibuprofen refill?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Please provide your full date of birth.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Sure, it's March eleventh, nineteen seventy-two. But, actually, my knee's been worse lately. Can I book an appointment instead?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Before we continue, could you please spell your first and last name to make sure I have it correct?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yeah, no problem. It's Robert, R-O-B-E-R-T. Alvarez, A-L-V-A-R-E-Z. So, do you have any openings?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: To help find your record, do you want to use the phone number you have on file with us?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: If so, please tell me that number. If you're not sure, I can confirm your name and date of birth again instead. Which would you prefer?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Let's go with the phone number. It's 805-555-0193. So, any appointment times?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I have your phone number as eight zero five five five five zero one nine three And your date of birth as March eleventh nineteen seventy two. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yes, that's right. So, when's the earliest I can come in? Also, can you still send that ibuprofen refill while we're at it?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I'm unable to find your record in our with the information provided. I can connect you to our patient support team for help, Would you like to continue with me, or should I transfer you now?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Let's try with patient support, please. But can you just hold on a sec? I really need that appointment and the refill
